# scripts/Visual/ArmReach.gd

[Source:1](../../../../../scripts/Visual/ArmReach.gd#L1)

Declarations come from source. Unannotated types are explicit; see the [system guides](../../../../systems/README.md) for runtime schemas, nullability, ownership, units and side effects.

Two-bone arm/leg IK and animation-derived finger curls layered over the current pose.
Targets use the owning Humanoid's full-size space, facing -Z; zero limb weight preserves its animation.
ViewArms drives this modifier for first-person arms.

Base: `SkeletonModifier3D`. Registered class: `none`.

### _solve

```gdscript
func _solve(skeleton: Skeleton3D, root_name: StringName, mid_name: StringName, tip_name: StringName, target: Transform3D, weight: float, hint: Vector3, give: float, base_name: StringName = &"") -> void
```

[Source:144](../../../../../scripts/Visual/ArmReach.gd#L144)

Two-bone IK: `root` and `mid` bend so the end of `mid` (the `tip` bone's
joint) comes to `target`, bending toward `hint`; then `tip` takes the
target's turn. Out of reach, the limb straightens, and a clavicle, if
given, brings the root forward by up to `give`.

| Parameter | Type in source | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `skeleton` | `Skeleton3D` | required |

| `mid_name` | `StringName` | required |

| `give` | `float` | required |
| `base_name` | `StringName` | `&""` |

Return type: `void`.
